description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseLLM' implementing the 'ILLM' interface, providing core functionalities for language model interactions such as streaming completions, chat handling, reranking, and token counting. It manages API interactions, logging, and message formatting within a language model service framework.

classes.name: BaseLLM
classes.description: An abstract class providing core methods and properties for language model implementations, including streaming, chat, reranking, token counting, and API interaction management.

methods.name: supportsFim
methods.description: Indicates whether the model supports FIM (Fine-tuned Inference Mode). Returns false by default.

methods.name: supportsCompletions
methods.description: Determines if the model supports text completions based on provider and API base conditions.

methods.name: streamFim
methods.description: Streams FIM output chunks; not implemented in this class, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: streamComplete
methods.description: Streams completion output chunks; not implemented in this class, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: streamChat
methods.description: Streams chat message chunks; can be overridden, requires implementation of templateMessages or _streamComplete.

methods.name: _streamFim
methods.description: Abstract generator for FIM streaming; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: _streamComplete
methods.description: Abstract generator for completion streaming; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: _streamChat
methods.description: Streams chat message chunks based on _streamComplete; can be overridden.

methods.name: rerank
methods.description: Re-ranks chunks based on a query using the model's rerank method if supported.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Completes a prompt by aggregating chunks from _streamComplete.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Counts tokens in a given text using the model's tokenization.
